items.name: Cache
items.summary: A cache represents a partially computed DFA.

methods.name: clear_count
methods.summary: Returns the total number of times this cache has been cleared since it was either created or last reset.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the heap memory usage, in bytes, of this cache.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new cache for the given lazy DFA.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Reset this cache such that it can be used for searching with the given lazy DFA (and only that DFA).

methods.name: search_finish
methods.summary: Indicates that a search has finished at the given position.

methods.name: search_start
methods.summary: Initializes a new search starting at the given position.

methods.name: search_total_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of bytes that have been searched since this cache was last cleared.

methods.name: search_update
methods.summary: Updates the current search to indicate that it has search to the current position.

items.name: Config
items.summary: The configuration used for building a lazy DFA.

methods.name: byte_classes
methods.summary: Whether to attempt to shrink the size of the lazy DFA's alphabet or not.

methods.name: cache_capacity
methods.summary: Sets the maximum amount of heap memory, in bytes, to allocate to the cache for use during a lazy DFA search. If the lazy DFA would otherwise use more heap memory, then, depending on other configuration knobs, either stop the search and ret…

methods.name: get_byte_classes
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled byte classes or not. This is typically a debugging oriented option, as disabling it confers no speed benefit.

methods.name: get_cache_capacity
methods.summary: Returns the cache capacity set on this configuration.

methods.name: get_match_kind
methods.summary: Returns the match semantics set in this configuration.

methods.name: get_minimum_bytes_per_state
methods.summary: Returns, if set, the minimum number of bytes per state that need to be processed in order for the lazy DFA to keep going. If the minimum falls below this number (and the cache has been cleared a minimum number of times), then the lazy DFA…

methods.name: get_minimum_cache_capacity
methods.summary: Returns the minimum lazy DFA cache capacity required for the given NFA.

methods.name: get_minimum_cache_clear_count
methods.summary: Returns, if set, the minimum number of times the cache must be cleared before a lazy DFA search can give up. When no minimum is set, then a search will never quit and will always clear the cache whenever it fills up.

methods.name: get_prefilter
methods.summary: Returns the prefilter set in this configuration, if one at all.

methods.name: get_quit
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration will instruct the lazy DFA to enter a quit state whenever the given byte is seen during a search. When at least one byte has this enabled, it is possible for a search to return an error.

methods.name: get_skip_cache_capacity_check
methods.summary: Returns whether the cache capacity check should be skipped.

methods.name: get_specialize_start_states
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration will instruct the lazy DFA to "specialize" start states. When enabled, the lazy DFA will tag start states so that search routines using the lazy DFA can detect when it's in a start state and do some kind…

methods.name: get_starts_for_each_pattern
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled anchored starting states for every pattern in the DFA.

methods.name: get_unicode_word_boundary
methods.summary: Returns whether this configuration has enabled heuristic Unicode word boundary support. When enabled, it is possible for a search to return an error.

methods.name: match_kind
methods.summary: Set the desired match semantics.

methods.name: minimum_bytes_per_state
methods.summary: Configure a lazy DFA search to quit only when its efficiency drops below the given minimum.

methods.name: minimum_cache_clear_count
methods.summary: Configure a lazy DFA search to quit after a certain number of cache clearings.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Return a new default lazy DFA builder configuration.

methods.name: prefilter
methods.summary: Set a prefilter to be used whenever a start state is entered.

methods.name: quit
methods.signature: fn quit(self, byte: u8, yes: bool) -> Config
methods.summary: Add a "quit" byte to the lazy DFA.

methods.name: skip_cache_capacity_check
methods.summary: Configures construction of a lazy DFA to use the minimum cache capacity if the configured capacity is otherwise too small for the provided NFA.

methods.name: specialize_start_states
methods.summary: Enable specializing start states in the lazy DFA.

methods.name: starts_for_each_pattern
methods.summary: Whether to compile a separate start state for each pattern in the lazy DFA.

methods.name: unicode_word_boundary
methods.summary: Heuristically enable Unicode word boundaries.
